caption: Select the native decrypted text backup without a rename.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['standard-notes-import']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const path = 'Standard Notes Backup and Import File.txt'; if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path)) await app.vault.create(path, await app.vault.read(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Standard Notes Import/' + path))); p.settings.destination = 'Imported'; p.openImport(); const picker = document.querySelector('select[data-field=backup]'); picker.value = path; picker.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return picker.value; })()
after: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['standard-notes-import']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Standard Notes Backup and Import File.txt'); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Supported notes keep tags from both reference directions.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['standard-notes-import']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.signOut(); for (const path of ['Trip plan - 日本--sn-trip.md', 'Project notes--sn-work.md', 'A small idea--sn-idea.md']) { const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Standard Notes Import/Imported/' + path); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); } const input = await p.readBackup('Standard Notes Import/backup.json'); p.showReport(await p.inspectBackup(input, 'Standard Notes Import/Imported')); return 'ok'; })()
